goals.name: SEO Content Session Harness
goals.description: SEO Content Session Harness [seo-content-session] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hB-05-seo-content-session.yaml
goals.gate: Cluster mapped, gaps placed, and entity coverage at threshold.

gates.name: IG-01 Confirm the target query cluster and its dominant intent bef
gates.description: Confirm the target query cluster and its dominant intent before any outline work.

gates.name: IG-02 Confirm the content type (guide / listicle / comparison / de
gates.description: Confirm the content type (guide / listicle / comparison / definition) matches what actually ranks for the query.

gates.name: IG-03 Refuse keyword-stuffing directives; density targets above 2%
gates.description: Refuse keyword-stuffing directives; density targets above 2% trigger a degrade with written objection.

gates.name: IG-04 Confirm the page’s place in the site’s internal-link graph i
gates.description: Confirm the page’s place in the site’s internal-link graph is known before writing.

gates.name: CG-01 Query cluster map
gates.description: Primary query + >=4 secondary queries mapped with intent and funnel stage.

gates.name: CG-02 SERP feature audit
gates.description: Document which SERP features exist for the primary query (AI overview, PAA, video, images) and the plan to win each applicable one.
gates.command: $SESS/serp_features.md lists >=1 feature with a capture tactic; `grep -cE 'PAA|AI overview|featured snippet|video|image pack' $SESS/serp_features.md` >= 1

gates.name: CG-03 Competitor gap extraction
gates.description: Top 5 ranking pages analyzed; >=3 content gaps (subtopics none of them cover) identified and placed in outline.
gates.command: $SESS/gaps.yaml lists >=3 gaps each mapped to an H2 in outline.md; `python3 scripts/gap_map.py $SESS/gaps.yaml $SESS/outline.md` exits 0

gates.name: CG-04 Entity coverage
gates.description: Draft covers the entity set: primary entity + >=70% of salient related entities extracted from top results.

gates.name: CG-05 Heading hierarchy validity
gates.description: Exactly one H1 containing primary query variant; H2/H3 nest without skips; no heading is a question the body doesn't answer.

gates.name: CG-06 Snippet-target blocks
gates.description: >=2 snippet-eligible blocks (40-60 word definitional paragraph or 4-8 row table) placed directly under question H2s.

gates.name: CG-07 Internal link weave
gates.description: >=4 internal links with descriptive (non-'click here') anchors to pages declared in the link graph; zero broken targets.

gates.name: CG-08 E-E-A-T signals
gates.description: Author byline with credential line, >=2 outbound citations to authoritative sources, and a dated 'last reviewed' stamp.

gates.name: CG-09 Schema markup
gates.description: JSON-LD (Article or FAQPage as appropriate) validates with zero errors.

gates.name: CG-10 Cannibalization check
gates.description: No existing site URL already targets the primary query; if overlap >0.6 with an existing page, consolidate instead of publish.

gates.name: CG-11 Proof packet seal
gates.description: Cluster, gaps, draft, schema, and link proofs hashed.

preconditions.startup_phrase: I am the SEO Content operator. I write for the searcher’s next question, structure for the crawler, and never trade accuracy for rank.

self_improvement.pattern_cadence: After every 5 sessions, mine the JSONL log for recurring gate failures, degrade waivers, and proof-command runtime outliers; write findings to ~/.rig/logs/harnesses/patterns/seo-content-session-patterns.md.
self_improvement.update_trigger: If any single gate fails in >=30% of logged sessions over a rolling 20-session window, OR a new platform constraint (algorithm change, policy update, format deprecation) invalidates a proof command, propose a harness revision: bump the gate's proof, adjust its threshold, or split the gate — then re-seal with a new version hash.

success_conditions: Cluster mapped, gaps placed, and entity coverage at threshold.
Heading hierarchy and internal links machine-verified.
Zero cannibalization conflict, or consolidation decision recorded.
Proof packet sealed with all research and draft artifacts.
failure_states: halt: Stop the session immediately. Record the failing gate id, the proof command output, and the missing prerequisite in $SESS/proof/halt_log.yaml. Do not draft past a halt gate; resume only after the gate's proof exits 0.

degrade: Continue the session with the deficit logged in $SESS/proof/waivers.md (gate id, reason, owner). A degrade-tier failure blocks 'clean ship' status — the Definition of Done must record the waiver explicitly.

stop: Terminal condition. Seal whatever proof exists, write $SESS/proof/stop_reason.md, and exit. No outward action (publish, send, deploy) may follow a stop-tier failure without human Gate-D approval.

final_rule: Ship only what the gates can prove. No artifact leaves this session on adjectives — every claim is bound to a command, a file, or a hash. A blocked gate is information, not failure; log it, learn from it, and make the next session's proof stronger. The operator who follows this harness leaves the system stronger than it found it.
